tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant | E-Commerce, Integration & Business Analysis
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, and micro-services, with proven experience designing PIM-ERP-MDM integrations, data pipelines and API migrations. Skilled in business analysis, stakeholder management, user story creation and functional specification, operating in agile, techno-functional teams and leveraging AI-assisted development.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: E-Commerce Consultant (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by SUNZINET’s reputation as a leading SAP Commerce Cloud partner and its focus on innovative digital-commerce solutions. With more than five years of hands-on experience delivering SAP Commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to contribute to your consulting team.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211), covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data, following best practices and design patterns.

bullets.label: Integration & API Development
bullets.text: I built and exposed OCC REST web services and engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, ensuring seamless integration with SAP ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Working in a techno-functional role, I analysed business requirements, wrote user stories and functional specifications, and translated them into robust SAP Commerce solutions, supporting international stakeholders.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Leadership
bullets.text: I led code reviews, mentored junior developers, and executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2 within agile Scrum teams, delivering high-quality releases on schedule.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als E-Commerce Consultant (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Ich bin begeistert von SUNZINETs Position als führender SAP Commerce Cloud Partner und dem Fokus auf innovative digitale Handelslösungen. Mit über fünf Jahren Praxis in der Umsetzung von SAP-Commerce-Plattformen für Rockwell Automation und Shell möchte ich Ihr Beratungsteam verstärken.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Expertise
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich Backend- und Frontend-Funktionalitäten auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) entwickelt, einschließlich Produkt-, Katalog-, Preis- und Kundendaten, nach Best-Practice- und Design-Pattern-Standards.

bullets.label: Integration & API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Ich habe OCC-REST-Webservices erstellt und PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines mit Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub aufgebaut, um nahtlose Integrationen mit SAP ERP und MDM sicherzustellen.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: In einer techno-funktionalen Rolle analysierte ich Geschäftsanforderungen, erstellte User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen und setzte sie in robusten SAP-Commerce-Lösungen für internationale Stakeholder um.

bullets.label: Agile Lieferung & Führung
bullets.text: Ich leitete Code-Reviews, betreute Junior-Entwickler und führte CI/CD-Deployments auf CCv2 in agilen Scrum-Teams durch, um termingerechte, qualitativ hochwertige Releases zu gewährleisten.

cover_de.logistics: Karlsruhe, gültige Arbeitserlaubnis, letzter Arbeitstag 15.12.2026, freue mich auf ein Gespräch

tailoring.why_company: SUNZINET is recognized as a leading SAP Commerce Cloud partner that combines deep technical expertise with innovative digital-commerce strategies for enterprise clients. I am attracted by your commitment to delivering end-to-end, AI-enhanced commerce solutions and your collaborative, agile culture. My proven track record in SAP Commerce implementations, integration projects and techno-functional consulting aligns perfectly with SUNZINET’s mission to accelerate customer digital transformation.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join SUNZINET to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise and integration experience, driving innovative e-commerce solutions within a forward-thinking, agile team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering integration-rich e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about the E-Commerce Consultant role at SUNZINET and would love to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for E-Commerce Consultant (m/w/d) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the E-Commerce Consultant position at SUNZINET GmbH. With over five years of hands-on experience in SAP Commerce Cloud, integration, and techno-functional consulting for global enterprises, I am eager to contribute to your projects. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit further.
